name: io.github.vlad-public-code/valem
description: Deterministic reactive state models an agent can create, mutate, read, and verify over MCP — a spreadsheet-like computation core, not a text buffer.

environmentVariables.name: VALEM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Drive a remote valem-web server instead of the default embedded, in-memory mode. Leave unset for embedded.

environmentVariables.name: VALEM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the remote valem-web server (only used with VALEM_URL).
